text: もうかって　しかたないわ！

structure.en: so much I can't help it!

patterns.name: 〜てしかたない
patterns.span: もうかって　しかたないわ
patterns.explanation: The て-form followed by しかたない says something happens so much you can't do anything about it. もうかって　しかたない = 'we just can't stop making money'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end adds a light note of feeling to the statement. しかたないわ = 'can't help it, I tell you'.
